1. Information We Collect

TechApp does not collect personal information. We only use anonymized usage analytics to improve the app experience.

2. Third-Party Advertising

This app uses Google AdMob to display advertisements. AdMob may collect device information and use cookies to serve personalized ads. Please review Google's Privacy Policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy.

3. Data Storage

Tech tips and app links are fetched from our server and are not stored on your device permanently.

4. Internet Permission

This app requires internet access to load content from our backend and display advertisements.

5. Children's Privacy

This app does not knowingly collect data from children under 13.

6. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be reflected in the app.

7. Contact Us

For privacy concerns, contact us at: support@techapp.com
